evals.name: multi-sheet-conversion
evals.prompt: I've got an Excel file at excel-to-markdown-workspace/test-files/multi_sheet.xlsx that has employee data and department budgets on separate sheets. Convert the whole thing to Markdown so I can paste it into our wiki.
evals.expected_output: Two Markdown tables with ## Sheet headings, one for Employees (with dates formatted as YYYY-MM-DD, booleans as Yes/No) and one for Department Budget (with decimal numbers). Output should be a valid pipe table.

evals.name: sparse-data-compact
evals.prompt: This inventory spreadsheet (excel-to-markdown-workspace/test-files/sparse_data.xlsx) has a bunch of empty rows and columns mixed in. Clean it up and convert it to a Markdown table — remove the blanks, and add row numbers so I can reference items easily.
evals.expected_output: A single Markdown table with empty rows and columns stripped, a # index column added, containing 4 inventory items (A001-A004) with SKU, Product, Qty, Price columns.

evals.name: wide-table-special-chars
evals.prompt: Convert excel-to-markdown-workspace/test-files/wide_table.xlsx to markdown and save it as project_tracker.md. This has 9 columns so it's pretty wide, and some cells have pipe characters in the notes.
evals.expected_output: A Markdown file with a 9-column pipe table. Pipe characters in cell values must be escaped as \|. Dates as YYYY-MM-DD. The None/empty end-date for 'Mobile App' should be empty string. File saved to the specified path.
